title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: The hill you asked for: real leaves and detailed houses are in, and a fresh reviewer calls it clearly better than the old lumps, but both allowed rounds are spent and it still fails on specks of leaf floating off the crowns, some sky-coloured gaps in the hillside, and dark triangles on a few roofs. May I make a third try at those three faults?
sections.recommendation: Yes, one try, about 1 hour, then one review. Without it the better hill stays in the game with these faults listed. No web link: the answer is this page.
